title: Customer Profile API Design Review
brief: A cross-team design review note for a customer profile API, drafted from the systems analyst’s requirements and the engineering team’s capacity estimates.

slip.document:
# Customer Profile API Design Review
Design review record | 04/16/2026

## Participants and scope
Jamal Kim (software development), Ethan Haddad (systems analysis), and Dmitri Ferreira (platform engineering) reviewed the Clearwater customer profile API for the account servicing portal. The API returns customer name, mailing address, and Social Security number to authorized servicing staff.

## Requirements and capacity
Ethan's requirements summary specifies UUID version 4 as the customer ID format. It sets the upstream account service limit at 2,000 requests per minute. The portal is forecast to generate 900 requests per minute at peak. Dmitri's load test measured 250 requests per minute per application replica with the profile lookup enabled.

The proposed deployment uses three application replicas behind the existing load balancer. The team concluded that this configuration provides enough capacity for the forecast peak, with 750 requests per minute available. The load test used the same lookup behavior planned for the portal.

## Interface decisions
The endpoint is GET /v1/customers/{customerId}; responses use JSON and return HTTP 404 when the customer ID is not found. The platform team will expose the endpoint over HTTPS. The portal team will send 10-digit numeric customer IDs. The response schema and error codes will be documented in the API specification before implementation begins.

The endpoint returns the customer name, mailing address, and Social Security number to the portal for account servicing. The review record does not define how callers authenticate to the endpoint or how access to these fields is authorized.

## Actions
- Jamal will publish the API specification by 04/23/2026.
- Ethan will confirm the portal's peak-load forecast with the product team by 04/20/2026.
- Dmitri will repeat the load test with the production-equivalent database before release.

errors.quote: provides enough capacity for the forecast peak
errors.explanation: Three replicas at 250 requests per minute each provide 750 requests per minute, below the stated peak forecast of 900 requests per minute. The conclusion does not follow from the capacity figures.
errors.fix: does not provide enough capacity for the forecast peak

errors.quote: The portal team will send 10-digit numeric customer IDs.
errors.explanation: Ethan’s requirements summary specifies UUID version 4 as the customer ID format. The portal’s stated numeric format contradicts that requirement.
errors.fix: The portal team will send UUID version 4 customer IDs.

errors.quote: The endpoint returns the customer name, mailing address, and Social Security number to the portal for account servicing.
errors.explanation: The document specifies that the endpoint returns Social Security numbers but does not define caller authentication or authorization. The design needs an access-control requirement for this sensitive data before implementation.
errors.fix: The endpoint returns the customer name, mailing address, and Social Security number only to authenticated callers authorized for account servicing.
